summary_en: 500,000 Speem shares (100% stake) acquired via simplified share exchange. Exchange effective 2026-08-25. Speem becomes 100% consolidated subsidiary. Financial impact under review; earnings contribution to begin FY3/28 Q1 pending shareholder approval of fiscal year-end change.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Full Subsidiary Status of Speem Co., Ltd. via Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief: Kaihan Co., Ltd. announces completion of its acquisition of Speem Co., Ltd. via simplified share exchange effective 2026-08-25. The transaction was previously disclosed on 2026-07-15. Kaihan acquired all 500,000 issued shares of Speem, representing 100% of voting rights, and Speem is now a 100% consolidated subsidiary. The company states that financial impact is under review across all business units and will be disclosed promptly upon completion of the review. Speem's earnings contribution to Kaihan's consolidated financial statements is scheduled to begin in Q1 of FY3/28 (ending 2027-09-30), pending shareholder approval of the fiscal year-end change scheduled for September 2026.
